05 · MACHINE LEARNING
WHY LOGISTIC REGRESSION

Performance was close across models — Logistic Regression won on recall and clarity, not just accuracy.

tenure and monthly_charges dominate the decision — both directly actionable by the retention team.

Coefficients convert directly into odds ratios: each factor's effect on churn risk is explicit — unlike Random Forest's opaque, relative importance ranking.

Logistic Regression vs. Random Forest — why LogReg won

Interpretability

Missing a churner costs far more than a false alarm — LogReg's recall is 36% higher than Random Forest's, at a near-identical ROC-AUC.
